title: Landing refresh: 4-screenshot device carousel, tree-heart branding, favicon, and theme toggle fix

requirements.summary: Replace landing screenshot carousel to use exactly 4 uploaded screenshots with swipe, prev/next, and dots navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Landing carousel displays exactly 4 slides sourced from the uploaded files (not the existing /assets/generated/landing-screenshot-*.png files).
Swipe on mobile moves between all 4 slides; desktop prev/next buttons and dots navigate correctly.
No old placeholder “Amour Bloom” images appear anywhere in the carousel.

file_operations.description: Update the carousel data source to 4 slides referencing the new static assets at frontend/public/assets/generated/landing-screenshot-1.dim_390x844.jpg, frontend/public/assets/generated/landing-screenshot-2.dim_390x844.jpg, frontend/public/assets/generated/landing-screenshot-3.dim_390x844.jpg, and frontend/public/assets/generated/landing-screenshot-4.dim_390x844.jpg; remove references to the existing .png carousel images; ensure swipe, desktop next/prev, and dots work for 4 slides.

requirements.summary: Redesign the landing hero to feature the 4 screenshots in a polished device-frame carousel presentation while keeping existing hero copy and CTA.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section no longer renders the current hero illustration image; it instead features the uploaded screenshots in a cohesive presentation optimized for mobile and desktop.
Hero headline/subheadline/CTA remain present and readable across breakpoints.
Hero layout remains visually balanced (no overflow/cropping issues on common mobile widths).

file_operations.description: Create a dedicated hero-only screenshot presentation component that renders the 4 static screenshots in a clean device-frame style carousel (or equally polished presentation) using the same 4 assets: frontend/public/assets/generated/landing-screenshot-1.dim_390x844.jpg, frontend/public/assets/generated/landing-screenshot-2.dim_390x844.jpg, frontend/public/assets/generated/landing-screenshot-3.dim_390x844.jpg, frontend/public/assets/generated/landing-screenshot-4.dim_390x844.jpg.

Replace the existing hero illustration image with the new LandingHeroScreenshotShowcase component while keeping the hero headline, subheadline, and CTA unchanged; ensure the hero layout remains responsive and visually balanced across breakpoints.

requirements.summary: Limit usage of the uploaded screenshots to landing hero and/or landing carousel only.
acceptanceCriteria: No new references to the uploaded screenshot assets exist outside landing-page-related components/pages.

file_operations.description: Ensure this component is only imported/used from the landing page (frontend/src/pages/Landing.tsx) and does not introduce exports/usages that would encourage reuse in authenticated app pages.
Keep all screenshot asset references encapsulated within landing-only components (this carousel) and avoid re-exporting/repurposing the screenshot list for use elsewhere.

requirements.summary: Align landing branding imagery (header logo, footer logo, and any landing brand marks) to the tree-and-hearts logo style with consistent artwork across landing.
acceptanceCriteria: Landing header logo (top-left) and footer logo are visually consistent with the tree-and-hearts inspiration and match each other (no mixed logo styles).
Any other landing-page brand marks/thumbnails use the same landing logo artwork/style (no mismatched branding on landing).

file_operations.description: Add the refined tree-and-hearts-style logo icon asset as a static frontend file (per imageRequirements edit output) so the landing page can use consistent updated branding.
Add the refined tree-and-hearts-style wordmark asset as a static frontend file (per imageRequirements edit output) so the landing page can use consistent updated branding.

Update landing header (top-left) and footer logo usages to reference the refined assets at frontend/public/assets/generated/landing-logo-icon-transparent.v2.dim_256x256.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/landing-wordmark-transparent.v2.dim_720x200.png; ensure any other landing brand marks use the same updated artwork/style.

requirements.summary: Update favicon/app icons to match landing logo style and wire them into the static HTML head.
acceptanceCriteria: A favicon is present and visible in the browser tab and matches the landing logo style.
favicon assets are served as static frontend assets and referenced from frontend/index.html.

file_operations.description: Add the generated 32x32 favicon asset matching the tree-and-hearts style as a static frontend file.
Add the generated 16x16 favicon asset matching the tree-and-hearts style as a static frontend file.
Add the generated Apple touch icon matching the tree-and-hearts style as a static frontend file.
Add the generated Android 192x192 icon matching the tree-and-hearts style as a static frontend file.
Add the generated Android 512x512 icon matching the tree-and-hearts style as a static frontend file.

Wire favicon and app icon assets into the HTML head using the static files at frontend/public/assets/generated/favicon-32.dim_32x32.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/favicon-16.dim_16x16.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/apple-touch-icon.dim_180x180.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/android-chrome.dim_192x192.png, and frontend/public/assets/generated/android-chrome.dim_512x512.png so they appear in the browser tab and on supported platforms.

requirements.summary: Fix landing light/dark toggle to apply immediately and persistently using the existing ThemeProvider/ThemeContext, including landing gradients and card backgrounds.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the theme toggle on the landing page reliably switches between light and dark appearance.
Theme preference persists across refresh (localStorage) and applies on initial load.
No landing sections remain stuck in the wrong theme after toggling.

file_operations.description: Add a small pre-React theme initialization script in the HTML head that reads the saved theme from localStorage and applies the effective light/dark class to document.documentElement before the app renders, ensuring the landing page gradients/cards match the selected theme on initial load.

Harden ThemeProvider behavior so theme toggling updates the DOM class reliably and without landing-only inconsistencies; ensure localStorage persistence remains the source of truth for subsequent reloads.

Audit and adjust landing section backgrounds (including the page gradient and card backgrounds) to rely on theme-aware Tailwind tokens/variables (e.g., background/card/border) so the entire landing updates immediately when the ThemeToggle is used.

requirements.summary: Store the 4 uploaded screenshots as static frontend assets and reference them directly from landing components (no backend routing).
acceptanceCriteria: Screenshot image files are placed under frontend/public/assets/generated (or a consistent landing asset folder under public) and loaded via direct /assets/... URLs.
No backend code changes are required for serving these landing images.
